About.title: About Drive&Talk Academy
About.subtitle: Your bridge to language fluency, theory certification, and scientific expertise in the Netherlands.
About.missionText: Drive&Talk is an integrated language and vocational learning academy specializing in Dutch language immersion, English proficiency, Driving theory preparation, and Chemistry courses tailored for international students and working professionals across the Netherlands.

highlights.title: Dutch Language Immersion:
highlights.text: Focused on fast speaking skills, State Exam B1/B2 preparation and civic integration.

highlights.title: CBR Driving Theory:
highlights.text: Multilingual car theory lessons with up-to-date practice questions and hazard perception.

highlights.title: English Proficiency:
highlights.text: Professional training in business English for expats and professionals.

highlights.title: Chemistry & Vocational Courses:
highlights.text: Practical chemistry lessons for university students and laboratory staff.
